description: Audits on file for an entity: BCA-reviewed audits with firm, date, report link, findings by severity and BCA's editorial score (averaged into bca_editorial_score). Rows with source defillama are audit links from DefiLlama protocol metadata: firm parsed from the link, no date or findings. Partial when only such links are on file; unseeded when nothing is on file. Starter tier.
name: get_audit_reports
